class.name: LandscapeBrush
class.description: Holds brush settings (size, falloff, strength, alpha) and applies sculpt and paint tools to a [LandscapeData]. It is used by the landscape editor and can also deform or paint terrains at runtime: [codeblock] var brush = LandscapeBrush.new() brush.tool = LandscapeBrush.TOOL_SCULPT brush.size = 5.0 brush.strength = 1.0 brush.invert = true # Dig a crater. brush.apply($Landscape3D.data, $Landscape3D.global_to_local(impact_position)) [/codeblock] Positions are in the local space of the [Landscape3D]. Modified regions are notified to the data automatically.

method.name: apply
method.description: Applies one dab of [member tool] centered at [param local_center]. [param delta] scales the strength (use the time step for continuous strokes). Returns the modified texel rectangle.

method.name: apply_ramp
method.description: Builds a ramp between two local positions (using the heights of the positions), [member ramp_width] wide with the brush falloff on the sides. Returns the modified texel rectangle.

method.name: get_weight
method.description: Returns the weight of the brush at a normalized offset from its center ([code]-1..1[/code] on both axes), including the falloff or the alpha texture.

members.member: Optional grayscale image used as the brush shape instead of the circular falloff (alpha brush).

Slope (in degrees) above which [constant TOOL_EROSION] moves material down.

Whether [constant TOOL_FLATTEN] raises, lowers or does both.
Inverts the tool: lower instead of raise, erase instead of paint.
The material layer painted by the paint tools.
Size in meters of the noise features of [constant TOOL_NOISE] and [constant TOOL_PAINT_NOISE].
Width in meters of the ramps built by [method apply_ramp].
Radius of the brush in meters.
Kernel radius in texels of the smooth tools.
Height targeted by [constant TOOL_FLATTEN], in local space.
Weight targeted by [constant TOOL_PAINT] and [constant TOOL_PAINT_FLATTEN].
Height of the steps of [constant TOOL_TERRACE].
